reason: My customers buy from me because they know me, from fairs and phone calls, not because of a message from some agency in Sofia. I might take the free call to see the 15 names, but I would not sign up for meetings this month; I would rather put Apollo and a junior on it myself and keep control.
objection: A meeting with a stranger who got a nice LinkedIn message is not a relationship. At EUR 300 a meeting I am paying for a first coffee, and in wholesale most of those go nowhere. One logistics client with 45 meetings tells me nothing about my sector.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies had real buyers I did not already know, and they booked me 3-4 meetings at my stand before the next fair, I would try the pilot.
